content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new here. I have a [product_name] with [version_no] and created a program using the [product_name] Web Editor. It works perfectly on my local network, but I can't access it remotely over the internet. I'm using a Huawei HG8245H modem and internet service from [company_name] in Mexico. I can't seem to open port 8080; although I made changes in the modem settings, port scans still show it as closed. Can someone help me with this issue? Thanks.

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Please note that English is the official language here. Kindly write future posts in English so everyone can participate. If you don't speak English, please use a translation tool such as Google Translate.

analysis.insight_summary: The user shares a positive experience using the [product_name] Web Editor locally, but encounters a significant problem: remote access through port 8080 does not work, as the modem continues to show the port as closed despite configuration attempts. The main insight points to a connectivity challenge between local and remote access, likely due to network or modem settings or restrictions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to remotely access the [product_name] web interface over the internet and expects to open port 8080 on their modem to achieve this.
